scope: All raw finite-family candidates, including zero remainders, preserved separately from immutable complete V3 parents

run_layout.protocol-degree4-witness.json: Frozen case, source, binary, budget and two-parent-archive identities
run_layout.case-specs/KEY.json: Exact selected frozen protocol case, including input/base and parent/suffix file hashes
run_layout.inputs/ARM/ID/{input.json,system.sing}: Byte-identical retained n83,m3,ell27 input and equation source
run_layout.v2/ARM/ID/: Retained complete V2 rows, operations and verdict required by V3 replay
run_layout.parent-reference.json: Immutable V3 prefix and continuation archive locations; both required for replay
run_layout.cases/KEY/source.fieldpoly: Complete first83 coordinate equations assembled into one GF(2^83)-coefficient polynomial
run_layout.cases/KEY/BLOCK.ordinary.fieldpoly: Ordinary product L*F before Boolean field reductions, BLOCK=X0,X1,U
run_layout.cases/KEY/BLOCK.normal.fieldpoly: Exact multilinear normal form, checked degree<=3
run_layout.cases/KEY/candidates.rows.u64le: 249 coordinate-polynomial rows, block order X0,X1,U, coordinate order0..82
run_layout.cases/KEY/remainders.rows.u64le: 249 corresponding deterministic highest-pivot remainders against the complete V3
run_layout.cases/KEY/candidates.jsonl: One record per candidate with byte offset, degree, row hashes, ordered V3 reducer IDs, remainder pivot and strictness
run_layout.cases/KEY/partial-NNN.json: Immutable progress totals after each complete83-coordinate block; raw rows flush after every candidate
run_layout.cases/KEY/family.json: Finite-family totals and complete multiplier coefficient/provenance records
run_layout.cases/KEY/result.json: Family result plus full input binding, verified parent replay and inherited/new lower-bound distinction
run_layout.status/KEY.json: Producer and fresh-replay exit codes; unsuccessful cases remain in summaries
run_layout.summary.json: Native12-case join with explicit statuses and null unknown exact/upper degrees
run_layout.status/summary-after-KEY.json: Write-once cumulative summary after each attempted case
run_layout.controls/: Independent tiny V3/V4 positive/null controls and native replay artifacts
run_layout.development-validation/: Tests, build records and retained failed control setup
run_layout.logs/,replay/,host.txt,terminal.json: Commands' outputs, process outcomes and non-secret host identity; no valid performance clock
run_layout.manifest.sha256: Final SHA256 inventory of every retained raw file except the inventory itself

record: degree entries of zero-based variable index:u16le
field_polynomial_binary.order: Lexicographic ascending variable-index vectors; vectors sorted internally, duplicates retained in ordinary products
field_polynomial_binary.coefficients: Polynomial coefficient bits modulo z^83+z^45+z^2+z+1; tiny controls specify their field degree separately
field_polynomial_binary.boolean_correction: An ordinary monomial has at most one repeated variable i. Its difference from its squarefree normal form is (v_i^2+v_i) times the other factors, with the saved field coefficient. All such products have ordinary degree<=4.

dense_rows_binary.columns: Graded colex squarefree monomials through degree3: constant0; singleton i at1+i; pair i<j at1+n+C(j,2)+i; triple i<j<k at1+n+C(n,2)+C(k,3)+C(j,2)+i
dense_rows_binary.bits: LSB-first per u64, little-endian words; unused final-word bits zero
dense_rows_binary.partial: Header declares planned rows; an interrupted file may have fewer complete records and cannot be treated as a complete result

reducer_ids: Zero-based global insertion IDs in concatenated immutable32768-row prefix and completed suffix; IDs do not refer to candidates from this phase
remainder_convention: Repeatedly cancel the current highest pivot if V3 has that pivot; stop at zero or first pivot absent from V3. Nonzero remainders need not have every lower pivot eliminated; this is sufficient for strict nonmembership in a row-echelon basis.

claims.positive: Degree<=3 candidate has a degree<=4 membership derivation and nonzero remainder against complete V3, establishing LFD>=4 for that exact input
claims.null: All named candidates reduce to zero; no global upper bound follows
claims.unknown: Exact LFD and global upper bound remain JSON null; absent numeric measurements are omitted from the unified export
claims.review: Producer, fresh and restored replay do not constitute independent scientific review
